report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται οι πλάγιοι και χιαστοί σύνδεσµοι. Χωρίς παθολογικά ευρήµατα από τον έλεγχο του έσω µηνίσκου. Παθολογικο σήµα οριζόντιου προσανατολισµού αναγνωρίζεται στο πρόσθιο κέρας του έξω µηνίσκου στo πλαίσιo µικρής γραµµοειδούς ρήξης αυτού. Συνυπάρχει παραµηνισκική κύστη η οποία έχει διάµετρο 8mm. Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδοαρθρικά. Σηµειώνεται παρουσία εστιών ερυθρού µυελού στην άπω διάφυση του µηριαίου οστού άνευ κλινικής σηµασίας. Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο αρθρικός χόνδρος.

Blaga lateralna subluksacija tibije, sa valgus položajem koljena.
Interkondilarno straga nešto koštanog edema u femuru.
Degenerativne promjene u sklopu OA obostrano, izraženije lateralnog kompartmenta koljena, sa
uznapredovalom hondromalacijom i mjestimično potpunim gubitkom hrskavice, iregularnom konturom
i subhondralnom sklerozacijom zglobnih ploha.
Suprapateralno umjerena količina zglobnog izljeva, sa nešto izljeva straga, i distenzijom kapsule.
Veća, septirana poplitealna cista, dimenzija oko 35x35x65 mm (APxLLxCC).
Neurovaskularne strukture su urednog prikaza.
Lateralni menisk je insuficijentan, u cijelosti maceriran, ekstrudiran lateralno. Radijalna ruptura
stražnjeg korijena duljine oko 1 cm.
Horizontalna ruptura prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska i korpusa i kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg
roga sa komunikacijom sa obe artikulacijske plohe.
Ruptura dubokog sloja PCL-a i ozljeda posterolateralnog meniskokapsularnog spoja.
Popliteofibularni i arkuatni ligamenti su održani. Ostali dio PCL i tetiva bicepsa femorisa održanog
kontinuiteta.
Edematozna tetiva popliteusa proksimalno, u smislu distenzije ili parcijalne rupture. Distendiran
sinovijalni recesus poplitealne tetive. Mišićno-tetivni spoj djeluje održano.
Medijalni menisk je bez znakova rupture, sa edemom meniskokapsularnog spoja posteromedijalno.
Medijalni kolateralni kompleks je održan.
ACL se prati u kontinuitetu.
Vlakna tetive kvadricepsa održanog su kontinuiteta. Površinska medijalna vlakna patelarne tetive su
zadebljana, izmijenjenog signala. Prepatelarno edem supkutanih mekih česti.
Hondromalacija patele IV stupnja u području grebena, s manjim arealom subhondralnog edema, te
III stupnja u području medijalne fasete. Hrskavica je difuzno stanjena.
Hondromalacija trohlearne hrskavice III-IV stupnja.
MPFL i medijalni retinakulum su edematozni, sa parcijalnom rupturom prije spoja sa strukturama
MCL-a. Lateralni patelarni retinakulum je održan.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa te incipijentno hvatišta patelarnog
ligametna.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran; parcijalna ruptura anteromedijalnih vlakana u
distalnoj trećini.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Kompleksna, predominantno horizontalna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska uz
ekstruziju diska. Manja "ramp" lezija uz nekoliko sitnih cisti posteriorne zglobne kapsule.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba uz hondromalaciju II.
stupnja i sitne osteofite medijalnog kompartmenta - početne OA promjene.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 2. Hondromalacija lateralne fasete patele II. stupnja.
Sitna Baker cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Patellofemoral eklem osteoartriti patella medyal faseti ve trokleanın santraline lokalize kondral kalınlığın%50'sine ulaşan kıkırdak kaybı ve subkortikal medüller fibrokistik-fibrovasküler değişiklikler ile karakterize. Patellar tendonun patellaya yapışma yerinde fokal tendonozis. Bunun dışında ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Femur medyal kondilin posteromedyal köşesi düzeyindeki fokal bağ dokusu ödemi posteromedyal sürtünmeyi temsil edebilir. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral  köşe yapıları korunmuş. Diskoid lateral menisküs. Bunun dışında menisküsler normal.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. A mild fluid-filled Baker's cyst is also noted.  There is degenerate tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Myxoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus is also noted. Degenerate tearing of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is demonstrated.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning and fraying of the medial compartment articular cartilage. Mild - moderate thinning and fraying of the lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is also seen. No significant subchondral bony change. No cartilage loss. The patellofemoral articular cartilage is preserved.  
Conclusion: Medial and lateral compartment degenerate change with degenerate tearing of the medial and lateral menisci.

Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité significatif.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs légers à modérés impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne où il y a amincissement modéré du cartilage au condyle fémoral interne et au plafond tibial. Il y a léger amincissement du cartilage impliquant le compartiment externe.

Au niveau patellofémoral, il y a amincissement modéré à la partie centrale et médiale de la trochlée du fémur.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure complexe multidirectionnelle impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure. Il y a une composante horizontale s’étendant de la corne postérieure jusqu’au niveau du corps. Il y a un fragment déplacé du ménisque en provenance de la corne postérieure déplacée antérieure à la racine postérieure. Il y a aussi un fragment déplacé au niveau du corps du ménisque avec extrusion. Le ménisque externe démontre des changements dégénératifs intra-substance sans déchirure linéaire bien définie.

Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Légers changements dégénératifs plus proéminents au niveau du compartiment interne.

2. Progression de la déchirure méniscale du ménisque interne avec une déchirure complexe multidirectionnelle avec multiples fragments déplacés (composante de type FLAP) tel que détaillé ci-haut.

3. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküs ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Medyal patellar sinovyal plika eklem aralığına uzanıyor ancak kalınlığı ve intensitesi korunmuş. Kıkırdak anormalliği eşlik etmiyor.

Hallazgos:

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que contacta la
superficie articular inferior de manera periférica superan una rotura, no desplazada.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de distribución difusa de los compartimentos femorotibiales
con úlceras de espesor total de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Discretas proliferaciones óseas periféricas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del cartílago troclear de distribución difusa. Úlceras
condrales focales de espesor parcial de la rótula con úlcera condral focal de espesor total de la
faceta lateral con cambios óseos secundarios.
Leve derrame articular. No hay signos de sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales y rotulianas proximales.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos sugerentes de una rotura periférica del menisco medial, degenerativa, no desplazada.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de los compartimentos femorotibiales con úlceras grado 3 del
aspecto central del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía con lesión focal grado 4 de la rótula. Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la tróclea
femoral.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales y rotulianas proximales.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.16 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. A 4 mm sclerotic focus in the lateral femoral condyle is most compatible with a bone island.. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondral fissure at the posterior nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle with subchondral cystic change and edema.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps tendinosis with tendinous thickening, intrasubstance signal alteration, peritendinitis, and edema in the quadriceps fat pad.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis with mild tendon thickening and peritendinous edema.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Extensor mechanism tendinosis and peritendinitis with edema in the quadriceps fat pad.
2. High-grade chondral fissuring at the posterior nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle.
3. No meniscal tear or ligamentous injury.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи дясната колянна  става са с нормална форма и структура. Вижда се контузионен костномозъчен едем в областта на латералния кондил на тибията. Няма данни за фрактура.
